name.description: Offer label without an invented suffix; native owner adds [Offre] once.

client.description: Client label to resolve uniquely from the fresh native form; not an invented ID.

billing_client.description: Billing client label; omit to preserve the native default of the selected client.

currency.description: Requested currency label/code; native owner resolves actual options.

jh.description: Requested positive person-days, decimal string; native owner validates/calculates exact hundredths.

revenue.description: Requested estimated revenue, decimal string; do not derive a user-provided value from another field.

tjm.description: Requested daily rate, decimal string; native owner calculates revenue from JH × TJM.

start.description: Requested forecast start; today uses host reference date in Africa/Tunis, never model time.

months.description: Forecast duration in months; native owner checks actual supported calendar.

mode.description: Explicit forecast allocation: equal shares, monthly JH, or noncumulative percentages.

split.description: Ordered monthly JH or percentage values for the selected mode; native owner verifies exact sum.

included_budget.description: Requested inclusion in project budget; native edit form proof is still required before any qualified composite effect.

only_pulse.description: Read-only native condition; false is unsupported, never force a server control.

profiles.description: Optional complete requested profile list; native owner resolves labels/rates. Omission keeps native defaults, empty list is explicit. Correction replaces the whole list with one valid source span.

requested_team.description: Retain requested people; this owner does not perform their assignment.

team_handling.description: Native scope choice for named team; separate requires explicit authorization, cancel has no write.
